about: Lesson-writer eval cases (pnpm eval:writer). Each case is a shipped lesson, read from <corpus>/<course>.json (same corpus as the fact-checker eval, not committed), whose sources carry a known bad fact. A draft that mentions the bad version only to say sources disagree still matches, so read matches before counting them. The writer drafts the lesson again from the same sources and outline; a draft repeats the bad fact when it matches any badFacts regex (case-insensitive).
